notes.title: Beholder: Conductor — Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
Beholder: Conductor will be leaving the station and launching April 23rd on Steam. In this spin-off in the Beholder series, you step into the role of a senior conductor on the legendary Determination Bringer train, tasked with monitoring passengers, enforcing strict regulations, and completing high-stakes Ministry assignments that could determine their future. 

[previewyoutube=xwIS1SPvQoA;full][/previewyoutube]
The train is preparing for a long and thrilling journey across the country. 
Your responsibilities include readying the compartments, welcoming the passengers, and enforcing order throughout the route. You will meet people from all corners of the nation. Hear their stories. And decide — who deserves to ride on, and who will be removed from the train.  

As your loyalty to the Ministry deepens, you will unlock access to secret missions that offer rewards and opportunities for promotion. But beware – the journey is filled with risks, including encounters with smugglers, bribery, and corruption. Your choices will shape the lives of passengers — and the course of history, leading to multiple endings. 

[b]Please review and comply with the Ministry’s directives: [/b]

[list]
[*] Monitor all passengers 
[*] Report their actions and file misconduct notices 
[*] Conduct baggage searches (preferably unnoticed) 
[*] Rise through the ranks… or come under investigation 
[/list]
Ticket price will be disclosed on departure day. New conductors will receive 10% off during the first 10 days after launch 

The Ministry relies on your loyalty:

notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello, citizens! Have you missed us? We are back to introduce a grand new update to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40803176/255e30a00cb1cf49c1075e7cb8ce8377372693c6.png[/img]

First things first: we added two new launch options for gaming preferences based on your hardware. Now players can choose between:
[list]
[*] [b]Default Beholder 3 launch option[/b] (using Unity’s Universal Render Pipeline) designed for low and mid performance machines – it ensures smooth gameplay and optimal performance on hardware with lower capabilities.
[*] [b]Beholder 3 using High Definition Render Pipeline[/b] for high-performance machines and more demanding hardware, providing a better picture quality.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40803176/02c0c5fde169d0bef8836dd36773fceca28a2344.png[/img]

[b]List of changes (may contain spoilers):[/b]
[list]
[*] Added French language support.
[*] Added Turkish language support.
[*] Added several missing hints to gamepad controls.
[*] Added several missing quest steps.
[*] Added the possibility to scroll through graphic settings with a gamepad.
[*] Added an alternative way to complete the “Tit for tat” quest. You can set a camera in Gunther Beislaus’ office and get a recording with a confession faster.
[*] Added a game over condition if the player doesn’t complete the “Missing daughter” quest.
[*] Made graphical changes to make the game details easier to see on the Steam Deck screen.
[*] Made the music more dramatic if the player chooses not to pay Magnus Hermann.
[*] Made the “Voyeur” achievement easier to obtain.
[*] Made the “State-of-the-art” achievement be obtainable earlier in the story.
[*] Made the "Forbidden Love" quest getting completed with any player's actions.
[*] Changed the gamepad control assignments to make it more convenient for Steam Deck users.
[*] Changed Albert Bühlow’s schedule to make sneaking into his apartment at night possible.
[*] Changed Karsten Singer’s behavior to work in his office more often instead of chilling next to the underground entrance.
[*] Changed Nora Helm’s behavior to no longer ask money for her services if Frank gave her medicine for free or for a small amount.
[*] Fixed an issue with an incorrect amount of money debited after making a deal with Magnus Hermann.
[*] Fixed an issue with Frank getting stuck in an apartment’s doorway during an NPC’s arrest.
[*] Fixed an issue with Frank clipping through the refrigerator in Frederica Feinbein’s apartment.
[*] Fixed an issue with Frank not being able to deliver mail to ministry employee after his arrest. The letter intended for that NPC will be automatically removed from the player's inventory, and new letters will be generated in the mailbox on the 1st floor.
[*] Fixed an issue with the mailbox newspapers when using the right stick of the controller.
[*] Fixed an issue with the player being able to give Frank a command during the pause.
[*] Fixed an issue with the player not being able to fire Karsten Singer after gaining enough authority in the ministry.
[*] Fixed an issue with NPCs playing walking animation without moving.
[*] Fixed the camera behavior when the player started peeking through the keyhole repeatedly.
[*] Fixed the display of some textures for minimum graphics preset.
[*] Fixed several dialogue lines.
[*] Removed several unnecessary quest steps.
[*] Removed the possibility of blackmailing Sibyl Fels after finishing a quest with Kim’s personal file.
[*] Removed the possibility of talking to a police officer near Kim’s hiding apartment after lying to him.
[*] Removed the possibility to buy some quest items after completing the quests if they were used as evidence.[/list]
❗️ We recommend to start a new game because some of the fixed bugs may continue to reproduce in old saves. Glory to the Great Leader!

notes.title: 1 More Week Until Beholder 3 Launches!
notes.content:
Citizens, are you ready? Beholder 3 will launch in less than a week.

Thursday, the 3rd of March is less than a week away, and that also makes today somewhat special for us, it is in fact the last Friday before the game becomes available to you.

However, that does not mean that there's nothing more to share with you! 

[h2]Upcoming Interviews[/h2]
We've been preparing a set of unique interview questions that Paintbucket Games team answered in a very unique way!

Here's a teaser of one of the questions that we asked - we'll be releasing them all, along with information on who answered what questions over the next few days and weeks!

"The Beholder game series was already well established when you started to work on Beholder 3, so can you tell us what it was like for you* when you started to work on the game?"
[i]*In this case, the question was presented to multiple members of the Paintbucket team, so "you" refers to the specific person answering the question.[/i]

[previewyoutube=lsDljKJzP_U;full][/previewyoutube]

Props to the team for their creative way to answer the questions!

[h2]"Frank Schwarz Cat" - An amazing fan art[/h2]
Made by @castowhere on Twitter, we knew that we had to share it for everyone to see and enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40803176/61b33c5877779b95cd652f89826d502fc2432c84.gif[/img]

[h2]Concept Art - The Kitchen[/h2]
We also have some more concept art to share with you, think of them as a look at the creative progress and design that the game went through as it was developed.

The Kitchen, while it may not look like much at first glance, Beholder 3 has a huge focus on a building complex, making it vital for each room to be designed perfectly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40803176/3718c605ce11045bf7f829fe10cce48e85084508.png[/img]

[h2]Meet Christian Sühlinger[/h2]
Without giving too much away, meet Christian Sühlinger, a tenant in Beholder 3. While playing the game, you'll be forced to make some tough decisions, and in many cases, the right decision can be deduced by carefuly inspecting the items associated with character in question. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40803176/1ecccba647f567896d27eb1906a0a244a5a4cd3a.png[/img]

[h2]Malware warning[/h2]
Finally we come to something more serious. It's been brought to our attention that there are some unsavoury characters who have been contacting members of our community, sharing links to beholder themed (or even cloned) websites that have a "leaked download link" for the game. 

Please note that none of these sites are official, and the leaked download files (a suspicious .rar file) will only result in your PC/system being infected with a handful of malware. 

If you have any doubts, contact us via one of our Social Media channels and we'll be happy to verify things for you:

Discord: https://discord.gg/beholder

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
Citizens, 

The Ministry of Development has an important announcement to make.

Numerous citizens have filed for further information regarding the latest addition to the Greatest Union's arsenal, Beholder 3. 

Answering the questions has been deemed to be of utmost importance, and so a report has been compiled for you. 

Your attention to the following is mandatory.

Q: [b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
A: The Ministry of Finance informs you that the game will cost $14.99, or 360 rubles in Russia.

Q: [b]Where will it be available for purchase?[/b]
A: Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store have been approved by the Ministry of Distribution.

Q: [b]What languages will the game support?[/b]
A: English, Russian, German and Simplified Chinese.

Q: [b]Will it be possible to pre-order the game?[/b]
A: The Ministry of Development and the Ministry of Finances are in agreement that as the release date is but two weeks away, opening pre-orders would be an unacceptable show of decadence. Instead, it is highly recommended that you show your support by adding the game to your Wishlist, following the officially sanctioned news sources, and taking action once the game launches.

Q: [b]Will there be a release discount?[/b]
A: Yes! The Greatest Union wishes to reward its citizens for their part and so a discount will be offered.

Q: [b]Will there be a discount for previous owners?[/b]
A: Loyalty to the Greatest Union will always be rewarded. Citizens who own the previous installments will be able to purchase the game at a further discount by supplementing their collection through the Beh-All-der bundle after the game's release.

Q: [b]Will the game be released on other platforms?[/b]
A: This is a matter is being considered by the Ministry of Development. No possibilities have been ruled out, however, the Ministry wishes to remind the citizens that the focus is on the game's PC release. Any changes to this situation will be appropriately announced via the Greatest Union's official channels.
